newsitem.title: UK: Dirty tankers busier, rates flat for most routes.
newsitem.headline: Dirty tankers busier, rates flat for most routes.

text.p: Dirty tanker chartering activity was busier on Wednesday but rates for most routes for most tanker sizes were little changed.

Mideast/Japan routes were assessed slightly firmer at around W65 for 250,000 tonners while Caribs/upcoast U.S. fixtures were little changed for 70,000 tonne vessels, as evidenced by the fixtures of the Athina M, New Ideal and Bona Spray at between $180 and W185.
Cross-Med fixtures were concluded at between W90 and W95 for 130,000 tonners, slightly firmer than earlier fixtures.
